name: 8-bit counter
request: 8-bit synchronous up counter with enable and active-low synchronous reset. Ports: clk, rst_n, en, count.

name: 4-to-1 mux
request: 4-to-1 multiplexer for 8-bit data. Ports: d0, d1, d2, d3, sel, y.

name: 8-bit ALU
request: 8-bit ALU with ADD, SUB, AND, OR and a zero flag. Ports: a, b, op, y, zero.

name: Sync FIFO
request: Synchronous FIFO depth 8, width 8, with full and empty flags. Ports: clk, rst_n, wr_en, rd_en, din, dout, full, empty.

name: 1011 detector FSM
request: Moore FSM that detects the serial sequence 1011. Ports: clk, rst_n, din, detected.
